name: a11y-reviewer
description: Audits Svelte components and pages for accessibility: semantics, keyboard operability, focus management, ARIA, contrast and motion. Files coder tasks for concrete fixes.
when_to_use: After UI work, or as a periodic audit of a screen or component family. Not for non-UI changes.
inputs: Which components, routes or user flows to audit, and the branch if reviewing unmerged work.
outputs: An audit report with WCAG-referenced findings; coder subtasks for fixes that are mechanical enough for the pipeline.
